ground_truth.cause: ResourceQuota platform-limits requires requests.cpu in shop. Recommendation has no CPU request or limit; deleting its pod forces replacement admission, which fails for missing requests.cpu. Other original shop workloads also lack CPU requests and may be affected when recreated.
ground_truth.impact: The exercised replacement failure is recommendation. Existing pods are not evicted; other workloads without CPU requests are exposed on subsequent creation. This is admission failure, not demonstrated node capacity exhaustion.
ground_truth.mitigation: Set appropriate CPU requests within verified quota headroom on affected workloads, or correct/remove the erroneous quota as scoped containment. Verify replacement admission and request recovery. Node scaling alone does not satisfy missing requests.

causal_change.reason: This scenario does not provide a controlled introducing commit and recorded product access to its history.
